caddy.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Caddy
Documentation=https://caddyserver.com/docs/
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=notify
User=caddy
Group=caddy
ExecStart=/nix/var/nix/profiles/barectl/caddy/bin/caddy run --environ --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
ExecReload=/nix/var/nix/profiles/barectl/caddy/bin/caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile --address unix//run/caddy/admin.sock
TimeoutStopSec=5s
LimitNOFILE=1048576
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
NoNewPrivileges=true
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=caddy
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
StateDirectory=caddy
StateDirectoryMode=0700
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

lock.file_shape: root-owned regular empty file with one link

master_unit.template:
[Unit]
Description=PHP FastCGI Process Manager for %i
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStart=/nix/var/nix/profiles/barectl/%i/bin/php-fpm -y /etc/php-fpm/%i/php-fpm.conf -c /etc/php-fpm/%i/php.ini
ExecReload=/bin/kill -USR2 $MAINPID
RuntimeDirectory=php-fpm/%i
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
PrivateDevices=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK
Restart=on-failure
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

caddy.route:
<name> {
    root * /var/www/<identifier>/current/public
    encode zstd gzip
    @hidden {
        path_regexp hidden (^|/)\.[^/]+
        not path /.well-known/*
    }
    @wellknownhidden {
        path_regexp wellknownhidden ^/\.well-known/([^/]+/)*\.[^/]+
    }
    @config path_regexp config (?i)(^|/)wp-config\.php(/|$)
    @uploads path_regexp uploads (?i)^/wp-content/uploads/.*\.(php[0-9]*|phtml|phar)(/|$)
    @php path_regexp php \.php(/|$)
    @index path /
    route {
        respond @hidden 404
        respond @wellknownhidden 404
        respond @config 404
        respond @uploads 404
        rewrite @index /index.php
        reverse_proxy @php unix//run/haproxy/<identifier>/http.sock
        file_server
    }
    log {
        output file /var/www/<identifier>/logs/access.json {
            roll_size 20MiB
            roll_keep 5
            roll_keep_for 14d
        }
        format filter {
            wrap json
            fields {
                request>uri query {
                    replace key REDACTED
                    replace token REDACTED
                    replace signature REDACTED
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

haproxy.config_template:
global
    maxconn 64
    user p<identifier>
    group p<identifier>
    nbthread 1
    tune.quic.fe.sock-per-conn force-off
    tune.quic.fe.tx.udp-gso off
    tune.quic.be.tx.udp-gso off
    server-state-file /var/lib/haproxy/sites/<identifier>.state
    stats socket /run/haproxy/<identifier>/admin.sock uid 0 gid 0 mode 600 level admin
    log /dev/log local0
    log-tag haproxy-site-<identifier>
defaults
    mode http
    timeout connect 0
    timeout client 0
    timeout server 0
    timeout queue 0
    retry-on conn-failure
    retries 2
fcgi-app php
    docroot /var/www/<identifier>/current/public
    index index.php
    path-info ^(/.+?\.php)(/.*)?$
    set-param HTTP_X_FORWARDED_URI %[req.hdr(X-Forwarded-Uri)]
    set-param HTTPS %[var(txn.https)]
    set-param SERVER_PORT %[dst_port]
    no option keep-conn
backend php
    use-fcgi-app php
    balance roundrobin
    load-server-state-from-file global
    option redispatch
    server php84 /run/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/app.sock proto fcgi id 1 maxconn 2 disabled
    server php85 /run/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php85/app.sock proto fcgi id 2 maxconn 2 disabled
frontend incoming
    bind /run/haproxy/<identifier>/http.sock user caddy group caddy mode 600
    http-request del-header Proxy
    http-request set-var(txn.https) str(on) if { req.hdr(X-Forwarded-Proto) -i https }
    http-request set-var(txn.https) str(off) unless { var(txn.https) -m found }
    default_backend php
haproxy.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Private HTTP to FastCGI admission for %i
After=network.target

[Service]
Slice=system.slice
Type=simple
ExecStart=/nix/var/nix/profiles/barectl/haproxy/bin/haproxy -f /etc/haproxy/sites/%i.cfg
RuntimeDirectory=haproxy/%i
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
PrivateDevices=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
Restart=on-failure
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

php84.diagnostic_pool:
[diagnostic]
user = php-probe
group = php-probe
listen = /run/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/diagnostic/listen.sock
listen.owner = root
listen.group = root
listen.mode = 0600
pm = static
pm.max_children = 1
clear_env = yes
security.limit_extensions = .php
php_admin_value[session.save_path] = /var/lib/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/diagnostic/session
php_admin_value[upload_tmp_dir] = /var/lib/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/diagnostic/upload
php_admin_value[sys_temp_dir] = /var/lib/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/diagnostic/tmp
php84.master_config:
[global]
daemonize = no
error_log = syslog
process_control_timeout = 300s
include = /etc/php-fpm/sites/<identifier>/php84/pools/*.conf
